meta.disclaimer: Synthetic data for testing/demo. Not measured floor data. INR figures are plausible but invented.

incidents.title: Calibration Bench C1 reference drift found during audit
incidents.problem: Annual audit found C1's reference standard had drifted 0.4% over the year; 3 weeks of PT-3051 calibrations were within tolerance but on an uncertified bench.
incidents.rootCause: No scheduled re-certification interval for bench standards; drift went undetected between annual audits.
incidents.correctiveAction: Re-certified C1, re-verified the 3 weeks of affected units (all passed), issued supplementary certificates.
incidents.systemChange: Introduced quarterly bench-standard re-certification and a drift log per bench.
incidents.businessEffect: No units shipped bad, but 210 units needed re-verification; minor schedule slip. Cost mostly labour.

incidents.title: Bad diaphragm lot from DiaphaCorp causes DP-2051 zero-shift
incidents.problem: A diaphragm lot with out-of-spec thickness caused zero-shift in DP-2051 units; caught at final calibration, 40 units scrapped.
incidents.rootCause: Incoming inspection sampled 2% and missed a within-lot thickness gradient.
incidents.correctiveAction: Quarantined the lot, scrapped 40 units, expedited a replacement lot, re-ran the batch.
incidents.systemChange: Raised diaphragm incoming-inspection sampling from 2% to 8% with thickness mapping; added DiaphaCorp to watch-list.
incidents.businessEffect: Order shipped 9 days late; customer accepted with a penalty. Scrap + penalty + expedite cost.

incidents.title: Housing finish variation causes cosmetic rejects
incidents.problem: CastWorks finish variation caused cosmetic rejects at final inspection.
incidents.rootCause: No finish standard on incoming.
incidents.correctiveAction: Reworked/refinished; set a finish standard.
incidents.systemChange: Added finish acceptance criteria to incoming.
incidents.businessEffect: Minor scrap/rework. Contained.

incidents.title: Calibration technician attrition leaves single-bench coverage
incidents.problem: Two of four calibration techs resigned within a month; only one bench could run on Shift C for six weeks.
incidents.rootCause: No cross-training; calibration skill concentrated in a few people; no bench-C staffing buffer.
incidents.correctiveAction: Overtime on Shifts A/B, deferred low-priority orders, hired and trained two techs.
incidents.systemChange: Started a calibration cross-training program; set a minimum 2-tech-per-shift staffing floor.
incidents.businessEffect: Throughput down ~18% for six weeks; two orders slipped but none lost. Overtime cost.

incidents.title: Helium leak escape reaches Northwind — field failures
incidents.problem: Helium leak rig H1's calibration had drifted; 12 PT-3051 units passed leak test but failed in the field at Northwind within 3 months.
incidents.rootCause: H1 not on a calibration schedule; a slow calibration drift let marginal-leak units pass.
incidents.correctiveAction: Field recall of the 12 units, root-caused H1, re-tested the whole shipment's retained samples.
incidents.systemChange: Put H1 on a monthly calibration cycle with a control-standard leak check each shift; added retained-sample policy.
incidents.businessEffect: Recall + field-service + reputational hit with a key account. Northwind put Meridian on a 6-month probation.

incidents.title: Kova Automotive cancels order after repeated NCR failures
incidents.problem: Two consecutive TT-644 batches for Kova failed burn-in with high infant-mortality; NovaCircuit PCB solder-joint defects plus a burn-in profile that was too short to catch them. Kova cancelled the ₹1.8 cr follow-on order and dual-sourced.
incidents.rootCause: PCB supplier quality slippage + a burn-in soak duration set for cost, not for defect capture; no incoming AOI on PCBs.
incidents.correctiveAction: Extended burn-in soak for TT-644, added AOI on incoming PCBs, issued 8D to NovaCircuit, scrapped both batches.
incidents.systemChange: Made burn-in duration a quality-owned (not planning-owned) parameter; added incoming AOI; introduced a supplier scorecard gating re-orders.
incidents.businessEffect: MAJOR: Kova cancelled the follow-on order and moved 40% of volume to a competitor. Direct scrap + lost order + lost future revenue.

incidents.title: Burn-in Chamber B4 thermal controller intermittent fault
incidents.problem: B4's thermal controller tripped intermittently before soak completion, silently aborting burn-in on some batches.
incidents.rootCause: Ageing controller; no alarm on incomplete soak, so aborts were not always noticed.
incidents.correctiveAction: Replaced the controller; re-ran affected batches; added a soak-completion alarm and logged interlock.
incidents.systemChange: Added incomplete-soak alarms on both chambers and a preventive-replacement schedule for controllers.
incidents.businessEffect: Caught before escape; ~1 week of rework. Contained.

incidents.title: Senztek sensor-capsule lead-time doubles; PT line starved
incidents.problem: Senztek's plant flood doubled sensor-capsule lead time from 4 to 9 weeks; the highest-volume PT line ran dry.
incidents.rootCause: Single-source dependency on Senztek for the SNS-88 capsule; no safety stock or qualified second source.
incidents.correctiveAction: Air-freighted a partial lot, re-sequenced production to non-PT work, negotiated a recovery schedule.
incidents.systemChange: Qualified a second capsule source; set a capsule safety-stock of 6 weeks for the SNS-88.
incidents.businessEffect: Brightline order 3 weeks late (accepted); PT throughput halved for a month. Expedite + idle cost.

incidents.title: Calibration Bench C1 PC/software crash loses a session's logs
incidents.problem: A bench-PC crash lost a calibration session's electronic records; units re-calibrated to be safe.
incidents.rootCause: No auto-save/backup on the bench software.
incidents.correctiveAction: Re-calibrated; added auto-save.
incidents.systemChange: Added continuous logging + nightly backup on bench PCs.
incidents.businessEffect: Re-work of one session. Contained.

incidents.title: Shift C skill gap slows differential-pressure calibration
incidents.problem: Newer Shift C techs took ~40% longer on DP-2051 calibration (the hardest to calibrate), creating a recurring overnight backlog.
incidents.rootCause: DP calibration expertise concentrated on day shifts; training didn't cover the DP edge cases.
incidents.correctiveAction: Paired senior techs onto Shift C temporarily; built a DP calibration playbook.
incidents.systemChange: Added DP-specific certification tier; routed complex DP work to certified techs.
incidents.businessEffect: Minor recurring slip until training landed; no orders lost.

incidents.title: Hydro-test procedure ambiguity causes DP re-work spike
incidents.problem: An ambiguous hydro-test pressure spec (1.5×MAWP vs 1.5×range) led to inconsistent testing; a batch was over-pressured and re-worked.
incidents.rootCause: Work instruction wording was ambiguous; two shifts interpreted it differently.
incidents.correctiveAction: Clarified the spec, re-tested the batch, re-trained both shifts.
incidents.systemChange: Rewrote hydro work-instruction with worked examples; added a spec-clarity review to the document-control process.
incidents.businessEffect: Contained; a week of rework. Drove a documentation-quality initiative.

incidents.title: Sensor-capsule packaging damage in transit from Senztek
incidents.problem: Transit damage to capsule packaging caused a few handling-damaged capsules.
incidents.rootCause: Inadequate transit packaging spec.
incidents.correctiveAction: Rejected damaged units; upgraded packaging spec.
incidents.systemChange: Set transit-packaging requirements with Senztek.
incidents.businessEffect: Minor rejects. Contained.

incidents.title: SMT line E1 placement-head failure halts all electronics
incidents.problem: E1's placement head failed; with a single SMT line, ALL electronics assembly stopped for 8 days awaiting a part.
incidents.rootCause: Single SMT line = single point of failure; critical spare not held on site.
incidents.correctiveAction: Emergency part air-freight, outsourced a batch of PCBA to a contract assembler to protect the Medisys order.
incidents.systemChange: Stocked critical SMT spares on-site; qualified a contract PCBA backup; began a business case for a second SMT line.
incidents.businessEffect: Medisys order protected via outsourcing (at cost); everything else slipped a week. Outsource premium + expedite.

incidents.title: Traceability gap: unit serial-to-cert linkage broken for a batch
incidents.problem: A batch shipped with serial-to-certificate linkage errors; traceability audit flagged it.
incidents.rootCause: Manual serial entry; no validation.
incidents.correctiveAction: Reconstructed linkage from records; re-issued certs.
incidents.systemChange: Barcode serial capture with validation at cert generation.
incidents.businessEffect: Audit finding, no bad hardware; drove traceability automation.

incidents.title: Housing porosity from CastWorks fails pressure integrity
incidents.problem: A CastWorks housing lot had porosity that failed hydro integrity on PT-3051; 25 units scrapped at test.
incidents.rootCause: Casting porosity within spec on paper but marginal; no incoming pressure-integrity check on housings.
incidents.correctiveAction: Scrapped 25, quarantined the lot, added a sample pressure check on incoming housings.
incidents.systemChange: Added incoming pressure-integrity sampling for housings; tightened the CastWorks spec.
incidents.businessEffect: Caught in-house, no escape; scrap cost. Contained.

incidents.title: Knowledge loss when senior calibration lead retires
incidents.problem: The retiring calibration lead held undocumented tribal knowledge on edge-case calibrations; error rates rose for two months after.
incidents.rootCause: Critical process knowledge undocumented; over-reliance on one expert.
incidents.correctiveAction: Recalled the lead as a part-time consultant to document methods; captured the edge cases.
incidents.systemChange: Built a calibration knowledge base (seed of the Knowledge Centre concept); mandated method documentation.
incidents.businessEffect: Temporary quality dip; drove the knowledge-management initiative that became the KC.

incidents.title: Field recall: TT-644 drift at Tatva Chemicals from bad cal profile
incidents.problem: A calibration-standard mix-up loaded the wrong temperature profile on C2; 60 TT-644 units drifted out of spec in the field at Tatva. Full shipment recalled.
incidents.rootCause: Cal standards not uniquely identified at the bench; wrong standard selected; no independent profile verification.
incidents.correctiveAction: Recalled and re-calibrated 60 units, root-caused, added a second-person profile verification.
incidents.systemChange: Barcoded all cal standards with bench-scan verification; added independent profile sign-off; standard traceability.
incidents.businessEffect: MAJOR: recall cost + Tatva demanded a corrective-action audit and held new orders for 4 months. Nearly lost the account; recovered after the audit.

incidents.title: Burn-in B3 door-seal degradation causes slow temperature ramp
incidents.problem: B3's door seal degraded, slowing the temperature ramp and stretching burn-in cycle time ~15%.
incidents.rootCause: Seal wear not on a preventive schedule.
incidents.correctiveAction: Replaced the seal; verified ramp.
incidents.systemChange: Added door-seal inspection to the chamber PM checklist.
incidents.businessEffect: Minor throughput drag until fixed. Contained.

incidents.title: Holiday-season staffing dip creates a short calibration backlog
incidents.problem: Concentrated holiday leave briefly thinned calibration staffing.
incidents.rootCause: Leave not staggered.
incidents.correctiveAction: Staggered leave; brief overtime.
incidents.systemChange: Leave-planning tied to the staffing floor.
incidents.businessEffect: Brief backlog. Contained.

incidents.title: NovaCircuit PCB counterfeit-component scare
incidents.problem: A suspected counterfeit component in a NovaCircuit PCB lot triggered a hold on all TT/LT electronics pending verification.
incidents.rootCause: No component-authenticity verification in incoming; supplier sub-tier not controlled.
incidents.correctiveAction: Held and tested the lot (authentic, but 2-week hold), added authenticity checks.
incidents.systemChange: Required supplier component-traceability certs; added authenticity spot-checks; sub-tier disclosure clause.
incidents.businessEffect: Two-week hold, precautionary; no bad parts shipped. Schedule cost only.

incidents.title: Peak-season overtime fatigue raises defect rate
incidents.problem: Sustained overtime during a demand peak correlated with a measurable rise in calibration errors and re-work.
incidents.rootCause: Capacity shortfall met with overtime rather than staffing; fatigue effects.
incidents.correctiveAction: Capped overtime, added a temp-staffing arrangement for peaks.
incidents.systemChange: Introduced a seasonal-staffing plan and an overtime ceiling tied to a defect-rate trigger.
incidents.businessEffect: Re-work cost during the peak; drove capacity planning changes.

incidents.title: Burn-in Chamber B4 replaced after repeated controller faults
incidents.problem: After recurring 2013/2017 faults, B4's ageing controller failed again; chamber refurbished.
incidents.rootCause: End-of-life equipment run too long.
incidents.correctiveAction: Refurbished B4 with a modern controller.
incidents.systemChange: Set equipment end-of-life replacement policy from fault history.
incidents.businessEffect: Planned downtime for refurb; ended recurring B4 issues.

incidents.title: Calibration Bench C2 environmental control failure
incidents.problem: C2's temperature/humidity control failed; calibrations run during the drift window were suspect and needed re-verification.
incidents.rootCause: No environmental alarm on the bench; drift ran for a shift before notice.
incidents.correctiveAction: Re-verified affected units, repaired the control, added environmental alarms.
incidents.systemChange: Added bench environmental monitoring with alarms and an auto-hold if out of range.
incidents.businessEffect: Re-verification labour; a Brightline batch slipped a few days. Contained.

incidents.title: SMT E1 solder-paste temperature excursion
incidents.problem: A fridge failure let solder paste warm; a suspect batch of boards was quarantined.
incidents.rootCause: No temperature alarm on paste storage.
incidents.correctiveAction: Quarantined and tested boards; added a storage alarm.
incidents.systemChange: Temperature monitoring/alarms on all consumable storage.
incidents.businessEffect: Precautionary hold; minimal scrap.

incidents.title: Documentation-pack errors cause dispatch holds
incidents.problem: Recurring errors in shipping document packs (wrong cal certs attached) held dispatches at the gate.
incidents.rootCause: Manual document assembly; no automated cert-to-order matching.
incidents.correctiveAction: Corrected packs, audited recent shipments.
incidents.systemChange: Automated cert-to-order matching in the dispatch step; barcode-verified document packs.
incidents.businessEffect: Dispatch delays, no bad shipments; drove document automation.

incidents.title: Pandemic lockdown: workforce and supply shock
incidents.problem: National lockdown cut on-site workforce to a skeleton crew and disrupted every supplier simultaneously; multiple orders at risk.
incidents.rootCause: External shock; no remote-capable planning; thin buffers.
incidents.correctiveAction: Prioritised essential-industry orders (refining, utilities), staggered shifts, remote planning, renegotiated dates with customers.
incidents.systemChange: Built remote-capable scheduling and approvals (seed of this scheduler); raised strategic safety-stock; multi-sourced critical items.
incidents.businessEffect: MAJOR: ~2 months at <40% output; several orders renegotiated, one small order cancelled by mutual agreement. Broad revenue hit but no account lost.

incidents.title: Post-lockdown demand snap-back overwhelms supply
incidents.problem: A sharp post-lockdown demand recovery hit thin inventories; multiple material shortages at once.
incidents.rootCause: Buffers depleted during the shutdown; suppliers also recovering.
incidents.correctiveAction: Allocation-based scheduling, prioritised by customer commitment and margin.
incidents.systemChange: Introduced demand-sensing and dynamic safety-stock tied to lead-time volatility.
incidents.businessEffect: Managed via allocation; some slips, no losses. Drove S&OP maturity.

incidents.title: Remote-approval teething issues during rapid rollout
incidents.problem: The hastily rolled-out remote approval flow had ambiguous states, causing a few duplicate approvals.
incidents.rootCause: Fast rollout without state hardening.
incidents.correctiveAction: Clarified approval states; de-duplicated.
incidents.systemChange: Hardened the approval state machine (informs this scheduler's design).
incidents.businessEffect: Process confusion, no product impact.

incidents.title: Calibration-standard supplier PreciCal delivery delay
incidents.problem: PreciCal delayed a reference-standard re-cert, risking bench certification lapse.
incidents.rootCause: Single cal-standard vendor; no buffer standard.
incidents.correctiveAction: Borrowed a certified standard; expedited re-cert.
incidents.systemChange: Kept a spare certified reference per bench type.
incidents.businessEffect: Averted a certification lapse. Contained.

incidents.title: Helium Leak Rig H1 sole-rig bottleneck constrains wet lines
incidents.problem: With a single helium leak rig, wet-line (PT/DP) throughput was capped; H1 became the chronic bottleneck as volume grew.
incidents.rootCause: Single leak rig sized for old volumes; demand outgrew it.
incidents.correctiveAction: Re-sequenced to smooth H1 load; scheduled a second rig purchase.
incidents.systemChange: Added a second helium leak rig (H2) the next quarter; leak test no longer sole-constrained.
incidents.businessEffect: Recurring slip until H2 arrived; capacity investment justified by the history.

incidents.title: Calibration rounding convention causes borderline cert failures
incidents.problem: Inconsistent rounding in calibration certs put a few borderline units on the wrong side of spec on paper.
incidents.rootCause: No standardised rounding/uncertainty convention across benches.
incidents.correctiveAction: Standardised the convention, re-issued affected certs.
incidents.systemChange: Codified a rounding/uncertainty standard in the cal procedure and cert template.
incidents.businessEffect: Paperwork only, no bad hardware. Contained.

incidents.title: Global chip shortage delays NovaCircuit PCBAs
incidents.problem: The semiconductor shortage stretched PCBA lead times to 20+ weeks; TT/LT electronics constrained for months.
incidents.rootCause: Industry-wide chip shortage; long-lead components single-sourced.
incidents.correctiveAction: Redesigned to a second-source MCU where possible; last-time-buy on critical parts; re-prioritised orders.
incidents.systemChange: Added component-risk scoring to design; multi-sourcing mandate for long-lead parts.
incidents.businessEffect: Managed via redesign and prioritisation; Medisys date renegotiated, retained. Engineering + premium cost.

incidents.title: Great-resignation churn erodes floor experience
incidents.problem: Elevated voluntary attrition across the floor lowered average experience; first-pass yield dipped for a quarter.
incidents.rootCause: Labour-market churn; retention lagged; onboarding too slow.
incidents.correctiveAction: Accelerated onboarding, mentorship pairing, retention adjustments.
incidents.systemChange: Built a structured skills matrix and a faster certification path; tied scheduling to certified-skill availability.
incidents.businessEffect: Temporary FPY dip; recovered as training matured. Re-work cost.

incidents.title: Predictive-maintenance miss: Test Station T2 unplanned outage
incidents.problem: T2 failed unexpectedly despite PM; a wear item wasn't on the checklist, causing a 4-day outage.
incidents.rootCause: PM checklist incomplete; a known wear item omitted.
incidents.correctiveAction: Repaired T2, moved work to T1, updated the PM checklist.
incidents.systemChange: Started condition-monitoring on test stations; data-driven PM intervals.
incidents.businessEffect: Contained via T1; minor slip. Drove predictive-maintenance adoption.

incidents.title: Marginal-capability calibration escapes to Orion Refining
incidents.problem: A gauge-capability (Gage R&R) gap on C3 for DP-2051 let marginal units pass; Orion flagged accuracy complaints (no field failure).
incidents.rootCause: C3's measurement system capability for DP was never formally validated; borderline repeatability.
incidents.correctiveAction: Validated and improved C3's DP capability, re-verified recent DP units, addressed Orion's complaint.
incidents.systemChange: Mandated periodic Gage R&R per bench per product; capability gating before a bench runs a product.
incidents.businessEffect: Caught as complaints, not failures; recovered the account relationship. Investigation + re-verify cost.

incidents.title: Night-shift lone-working policy slows escalations
incidents.problem: Thin Shift C staffing meant issues waited until day shift to escalate, slowing response.
incidents.rootCause: No on-call escalation for nights.
incidents.correctiveAction: Added a night on-call escalation path.
incidents.systemChange: Formalised 24/7 escalation; the scheduler surfaces overnight blocks to day-shift heads.
incidents.businessEffect: Slow escalations before the fix. Contained.

incidents.title: Diaphragm dual-source qualification pays off in a shortage
incidents.problem: DiaphaCorp had a shortage, but the second source qualified in 2011 absorbed demand with minimal disruption — a SUCCESS from a past lesson.
incidents.rootCause: N/A (this is a positive outcome of a prior corrective action).
incidents.correctiveAction: Shifted volume to the qualified second source seamlessly.
incidents.systemChange: Reinforced the multi-sourcing policy with evidence of value.
incidents.businessEffect: POSITIVE: near-zero disruption where a decade earlier this would have starved the line. Validated the strategy.

incidents.title: Second SMT line eliminates the single-point-of-failure risk
incidents.problem: An E1 fault occurred, but the second SMT line (added after 2015) absorbed the load — no electronics stoppage. Another SUCCESS.
incidents.rootCause: N/A (positive outcome of the 2015 corrective investment).
incidents.correctiveAction: Ran electronics on the second line during E1 repair.
incidents.systemChange: Confirmed the redundancy investment's value; formalised load-balancing between lines.
incidents.businessEffect: POSITIVE: zero stoppage where 2015 lost 8 days. Redundancy paid back.

incidents.title: NCR-2025-018: DP-2051 calibration slip caught by trend alert
incidents.problem: A slow calibration trend on C2 was caught by an automated trend-alert BEFORE any unit failed — early detection working.
incidents.rootCause: Minor reference creep, detected early by monitoring.
incidents.correctiveAction: Re-verified the standard, re-calibrated proactively.
incidents.systemChange: Trend-alerting (built from years of drift logs) now catches creep before escape — culmination of the drift-log history.
incidents.businessEffect: POSITIVE: prevented an escape; near-zero cost. The monitoring built from 14 years of incidents worked.

incidents.title: Cross-training buffer absorbs a sudden two-tech absence
incidents.problem: Two techs were suddenly absent, but cross-training (started 2012) meant other certified techs covered — no throughput loss.
incidents.rootCause: N/A (positive outcome of the 2012 cross-training program).
incidents.correctiveAction: Certified techs from other shifts covered calibration.
incidents.systemChange: Cross-training and the 2-tech floor proved their value again.
incidents.businessEffect: POSITIVE: zero slip where 2012's identical event cost six weeks of reduced throughput. The buffer worked.
